text:
noah-sales: Quick one — Clover Clinic asks for a hosted POC key. Conditions: chat+embed, IP allowlist for their demo laptop, TTL 24h, billing tag 'poc/clover', and they want evidence of rotation/revoke for SOC. Also they want the Console to mask the key (show only last4) so presenters can't copy full plaintext from UI.

rachel-eng: Yes. Hosted keys are masked in Console by default (last 4 chars shown). We can create key via API and upload plaintext to 1Password for the demo operator. Console Activity captures create/rotate/revoke events and we can export CSV for SOC.

noah-sales: They also asked whether we can include a signed audit bundle (CSV + signature) so their SOC can verify it wasn't tampered with.

oz-sec: We can produce an exported CSV and sign it with a Redwood platform HMAC key on request. That bundle includes create_time, actor, key_id, action, allowlist, TTL, metadata. Note: customers that require customer-managed signing need Private/Dedicated.

simon-ops: I'll provision. Send IPs + demo contact. Example create call (admin token redacted):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"poc-clover-demo","scopes":["chat","embeddings"],"expires_in":86400,"rate_limit":10,"allowlist_ips":["198.51.100.10"],"metadata":{"billing_tag":"poc/clover","contact":"demo@clover.example.com"}}'

vault-bot: key created: hosted_poc_clover_2177777777  created_by: simon-ops  expires_in: 24h  scopes: chat, embeddings  rate_limit:10 req/s

noah-sales: IPs: 198.51.100.10, 198.51.100.11, 198.51.100.12. Contact: demo@clover.example.com. They want the signed CSV after the demo and a one-line revocation URL in the playbook.

osz-sec: Typo: oz-sec here — revocation URL example in playbook: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/hosted_poc_clover_2177777777/revoke -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN'. For signed audit bundle we need an internal request; I'll file it and attach the HMAC-signed CSV to the deal folder post-demo.

simon-ops: Uploaded key plaintext to 1Password and replaced Console display with masked value. Playbook includes: store plaintext in 1Password, use Console mask during live demo, revoke if lost, export signed CSV and upload to deal vault.

vault-bot: key revoked: hosted_poc_clover_2177777777  revoked_by: simon-ops  revocation_time: 2177777850

noah-sales: Thanks — I shared the signed CSV and revoke screenshot with the customer; they were happy with the masked UI and the HMAC-signed audit bundle. Closing loop. :white_check_mark:
